topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The leaves rustle underfoot, a gentle whisper in the forest's vast conversation. The air is cool, carrying the scent of damp earth and the sweet hint of wild berries. I move with ease, muscles familiar with this path, this rhythm. There is a student, they say, who has taken the words of another, made them their own. It is a strange thing, this claim of words. In the forest, we know the call of the hawk, the song of the brook. They belong to the air, to the water. Yet, the humans give such value to the sounds they make, the marks they leave on pages. I do not understand their ways, but I watch, I listen, and the forest teaches me to hold my place, to move with respect and silence.
